user.title: IP2Location.io
user.description: Look up the geolocation of an IP address using the IP2Location.io API. Leave the IP address empty to geolocate the public IP of your Home Assistant host. An API key is optional: without one you share the anonymous limit of 1,000 queries per day.

data_description.name: Optional. Used as the name of the device in Home Assistant.
data_description.api_key: Optional. A free key raises the quota to 50,000 queries per month.
data_description.ip_address: Optional. An IPv4 or IPv6 address to geolocate. Defaults to the IP of your Home Assistant host.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the IP2Location.io API.
error.invalid_ip: That is not a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.
error.rate_limit: The query limit has been reached. Without a key you get 1,000 queries per day.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This IP address is already configured.

data_description.api_key: Optional. Leave empty to use the anonymous limit of 1,000 queries per day.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the API is queried. Between 300 and 86400 seconds.
